question_text: How many total events of any type were recorded across all cameras during the entire day of 2025-12-08 (UTC)?

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM events WHERE timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.note: Total event-volume sanity check across all 8 cameras and 5 event types.
